title: Ecru utility bills due Nov. 10; town says notices mailed Monday
excerpt: Ecru says utility bills were mailed Oct. 26 and are due Nov. 10. The town’s announcement includes a link to MSEZPay.
locality: Town of Ecru, Pontotoc County, Mississippi; town utility customers, not PEPA customers generally.

paragraphs.text: Ecru utility bills are due Tuesday, Nov. 10, according to a notice the town posted Wednesday morning. The Town of Ecru said the bills were mailed Monday, Oct. 26.
The town included a link to MSEZPay in its announcement. Both the original town notice and the payment-site link it supplied are available below for customers checking this billing cycle’s deadline.
